prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon preparation with carbohydrate loading and performance timing for long-distance endurance

solution_criteria: Provides 4-6 meals/snacks distributed throughout the day with timing guidance relative to training
Emphasizes carbohydrate-rich foods appropriate for endurance athlete (at least 7-10g carbs per kg body weight)
Includes pre-workout, during-workout (if applicable), and post-workout nutrition timing
Remains concise and compact in presentation (single day format)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate loading, with specific performance timing requirements

prompt_inputs.goal: muscle recovery and strength maintenance for weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one full day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
All meals are vegetarian with no animal flesh products
Provides adequate protein (minimum 1.6g per kg bodyweight) from plant-based sources
Macronutrient distribution supports muscle recovery (carbs 45-50%, protein 25-30%, fats 20-25%)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with dietary restrictions (vegetarian/vegan), requiring specific macro nutrient ratios for muscle recovery

prompt_inputs.goal: Lose 3 kg over 2 weeks for weight-class competition while maintaining boxing performance and strength

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 3-4 meals that create a moderate calorie deficit (approximately 300-500 kcal below maintenance)
Includes meal timing around training sessions (pre-workout carbs/protein, post-workout recovery nutrition)
All meals comply with vegetarian and dairy-free restrictions
Maintains adequate protein intake (minimum 1.6g per kg body weight) to preserve muscle during weight loss
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an athlete in a weight-class sport (boxer/wrestler) needing a controlled calorie deficit while maintaining performance, with meal timing around training sessions
